boundary: Anchor-level subgroup optimization only; full H145 restricted-representation branching, masses, Yukawas and phenomenology remain open.
interpretation: This is the largest residual symmetry of a five-generation anchor scaffold in the natural W33 point action. It is a concrete subgroup target for carrier surgery, not yet a proof that the full 75-state charged H145 subspace realizes this C6-by-A4 symmetry.
model: Represent the five repaired standard generations by five unlabeled anchor points in the natural 40-point PSp(4,3) action; maximize their setwise stabilizer.
proof: Exhaust all 5-subsets into 43 generator orbits. Stabilizer order is |PSp(4,3)|/orbit_size; the unique maximum has orbit size 360. Its action fixes the star center, induces the 12 even permutations A4 on the four leaves, and has a central six-element kernel with element-order profile of C6.
